newsitem.title: USA: Triumphant Clinton vows again to balance US budget.
newsitem.headline: Triumphant Clinton vows again to balance US budget.

text.p: President Clinton Wednesday repeated his pledge to balance the federal budget and called on Republicans to work with him for the good of the United States.
"We have work to do to keep our economy growing steadily and strong by balancing the budget," Clinton told supporters here after sweeping to victory in the presidential election.
Clinton, the first Democrat to win re-election in more than a half-century, will face both a Republican House and Senate.
"It is time to put country ahead of party," Clinton said, in appealing for Republican support for a politically centrist agenda.
